thesis: The earnings gap to 56.38 was sold into and faded, and price is now above the card's own entry zone (pre-market 53.0 vs zone 50.6-52.0), so buying means chasing a setup whose reward/risk is only about 1.04. The stock is up about 155% in 126 days and trades at EV/EBITDA 77.7 and forward P/E 34.1, with price already near the 54.8 mean analyst target (only 5 opinions), leaving little upside and a lot of profit-taking risk. The regime is risk-off with high confidence and tech is the lagging group (QQQ below 50/200-day, XLK and SMH sharply negative), which is a poor backdrop for an extended, high-multiple software name with ATR near 6% of price. Debt exceeds cash, GAAP profit is erratic (a -11.8M quarter followed by +12.3M), and the news feed is down, so guidance and any financing or headline risk are unchecked.
